reviewFlags.issue: The manufacturer's global page gives product dimensions 600*515*90 mm (height 90 mm). The Israeli Midea page and the Israeli retailer give 600x515x100 mm (height 100 mm). The sources conflict on height; the value above uses the Israeli figure of 100 mm. Check before publishing.
The manufacturer's global page labels the dimension order as width x depth x height (ר×ע×ג), while the row label used here is width x depth x height to match that order.
Israeli Midea page names the model as MG60GH096KT6BIR (no hyphen) with product code 6755, not the exact hyphenated string. Same product per the global page and retailer page.
Midea global IL page lists height 90 mm while the Israeli importer page and retailer list 100 mm; published 100 mm. Verify.
Catalog lists a small burner of 1KW; not confirmed by a quote, so not published as a fact.
Catalog's single-phase connection and FFD naming were not verifiable from sources.

qa.notes: All facts verified by ok quotes on pages naming the model. Height conflict (90 vs 100 mm) between Midea global page and Israeli sources flagged; kept Israeli importer figure of 100 mm. Small burner 1KW from catalog not evidenced as a fact. Adjusted safety fact label wording slightly.
